verdict.rationale: telli ships Charlie, a built-in AI assistant that builds and refines agents, automates workflows, and analyzes calls, so users can operate core product functions conversationally. Charlie is also reachable from external AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex) through telli's official MCP server. missing for 10: detailed docs on which operations Charlie can perform via natural-language commands and their limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Charlie: Build and refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze your calls with telli's built-in AI assistant.
The telli MCP server lets AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex talk to Charlie, telli's AI assistant, over the Model Context Protocol.
